Our new website is flashy, it's educational, and it's a great place to get started with Scribble! Our website was designed to help you get what you need out of Scribble. Our website includes a few major sections:

  • List of Available Addons
  • How to Install Scribble
  • Scribble Customization Tool
  • A Link to Our Github Code Repository

Along with the new website comes the biggest feature to Voat themes since... well, ever. You can now customize your Scribble installation with ease! Select the colors you want to see on your subverse, then select from any of our other available addons. Want to display a banner on your subverse? Select the addon, and enter your text; the tool will take care of the work, and give you the finished CSS to place in your "Subverse Settings" page. We even save your settings for use at a later time. How do we do this? We take your email address, and then your settings, and save them to our database. Don't worry! We will never give your email address away, nor will we sell it, and the only time we'll contact you is when there's an update to Scribble that we think you should be aware of (e.g. major bug fixes). The only reason we even ask for your email address is to ensure that you're staying as up to date as possible without having to constantly check back here. The tool is extremely powerful for beginners and web developers alike; it offers a great way to save your settings across multiple devices, so you can modify your theme wherever you happen to be.

Feel free to let me know what you guys think of the new site and the tool. I'm excited to see them finally be released, and I look forward to hearing about how I can improve the experience of each!
